decision: D-024 (option A; was O-18): Upgrade does not scan or list .deft/core references in files Directive doesn't own. content/UPGRADING.md's old-layout conversion section tells people to run git grep .deft/core after converting and to check CI conditions that test for .deft/core files (the #5961 case). No code change, no RC.

whyWinner: Directive doesn't read files it doesn't own; a docs note covers the case.
